 Luke Kennard leads Suns bench in win over Magic 
 by Garrett Ball | Suns Correspondent | Fri, Nov 6th 2026, 9:07am EST 
 Luke Kennard scored 12 points (4-8 FG, 3-6 3P, 1-2 FT) with a rebound and five assists in the Suns’ 117-104 win over the Magic on Thursday. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Kennard bounced back from a nearly silent outing against the Blazers on Wednesday, leading the Suns bench in points in the process. He’s not someone you should look to start, as his inconsistency combined with a low floor make him unreliable for fantasy.
